landing.tagline: Multi-company logistics platform for Angola and Africa
landing.title: Your entire logistics chain on one platform
landing.subtitle: Fixed-price on-demand freight with the nearest driver, blind-bid transport auctions and multimodal shipment management — road, rail, sea, river and air — on a secure, audited multi-company platform.
landing.f1d: A fixed price in kwanzas, calculated instantly. The request goes to the nearest verified driver, who has 30 s to accept.
landing.f2d: Verified providers bid until the deadline without seeing each other's bids. The shipper picks one and the shipment is booked.
landing.f3d: Trucks, trains, ships, barges and planes, with multimodal legs, warehouses, stevedoring, documents and tracking.
landing.f4d: Full isolation between companies, 11 roles with server-side permissions, a complete audit log, NIF and AOA.
landing.roadmapDesc: Phases 1 and 2 are live: foundation, shipments, documents, the auction marketplace and on-demand freight with the driver app.
